name: feedback-scope
body: The set of transient stores a project's feedback lives in: the plan store (`.trans/plans/<project>.jsonl`) plus the five feedback tier mirrors (`.trans/<tier>/<project>.jsonl`). Plan/phase/task-target reviews route to the plan store; durable-layer and code-target reviews route to a tier mirror. The pre-merge verify gate must span every scope — feedback in any store is feedback the gate must see.
